channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Disney names Josh D’Amaro as next CEO
item.description: Josh D’Amaro, a 28-year Disney veteran with vast theme park experience but little expertise in movies and television, will succeed Bob Iger as Disney’s CEO, ending a nearly three-year search, the company said today.

item.title: Gabbard: Trump directed her to attend FBI raid on Georgia election hub
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard said on Monday she was present at last week’s FBI raid on an election facility in Georgia at the request of President Donald Trump and that her attendance was within her authority.

item.title: Surf up to 45 feet to pound north shores; high surf warning in effect
item.description: A strong northwest swell and powerful cold front today triggered warnings for dangerous surf on most islands and stiff, gusty winds on Hawaii island summits.

item.title: Mountain West finalizes TV deal ahead of its first new-look season
item.description: The new-look Mountain West has completed its next television deal, continuing partnerships with CBS Sports and Fox Sports while also adding The CW to its linear lineup and moving the Mountain West app to a paywall service.

item.title: Trump signs bill to reopen government
item.description: WASHINGTON >> A partial government shutdown ended today as President Donald Trump signed a spending package to reopen major parts of the government as well as fund the Department of Homeland Security during his negotiations with Democrats over restrictions on the administration’s immigration crackdown.

item.title: Trump’s call to ‘nationalize’ elections draws pushback from Democrats
item.description: WASHINGTON >> President Donald Trump’s call for Republicans to “nationalize” elections drew pushback today from lawmakers, including a few Republicans, as Democrats voiced concerns that he intends to interfere with the November midterms that will determine control of Congress.

item.title: U.S. shoots down Iranian drone approaching aircraft carrier
item.description: The U.S. military today shot down an Iranian drone that “aggressively” approached the Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier in the Arabian Sea, the U.S. military said, in an incident first reported by Reuters.

item.title: RFK Jr.-aligned groups target vaccine mandate bans in 12 states
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. activists allied with Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. hope to ban vaccine mandates in as many as a dozen states this year, building on a law they conceived and passed in Idaho, according to interviews with three people working on the effort.

item.title: Wall Street ends down as traders fret about AI disruption
item.description: Wall Street ended lower today as investors worried about AI creating more competition for software makers, keeping them on edge ahead of quarterly reports from Alphabet and Amazon later this week.

item.title: Renee Good’s brothers urge Congress to rein in immigration crackdown
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Nearly one month after a federal immigration agent shot and killed Renee Good, 37, in Minneapolis, two of her siblings, Brent and Luke Ganger, appeared today on Capitol Hill and urged lawmakers to move to rein in the deportation crackdown.
